title: Seek the humble servant, not the impressive name
summary: The line refuses to let self-importance dress itself as honesty, intelligence, or force. Do not let the day outrun this: remember this: seek the humble servant, not the world's impressive names.
takeaway: Treat ego as illness, not identity.
lifeApplication: Before leaning toward the loudest or most decorated voice, ask who in the room is actually carrying humility.

source.shortMeaning: The humble servant carries more help than the impressive name.
source.lifeApplication: Before choosing the impressive voice, look for the one carrying humility.
